About Costa Rica

An adventure, a retreat, an experience

Whether you’re seeking an adrenaline rush or deep relaxation – or a little of both – Costa Rica is your ideal destination. We reserve more than a quarter of our land for conservation, meaning undisturbed natural beauty is yours to enjoy. Top attractions with many activities call to visitors from across the globe. Then in vibrant cities you’ll find fascinating art, history and entertainment. We even have an official “Blue Zone” in the Nicoya Peninsula, meaning we have a high number of centenarians thanks to our balanced diet, active lifestyle, strong social bonds and integrated health care practices.

Caribbean

An enchanting combination of nature reserves and Afro Caribbean culture, the Caribbean region of Costa Rica is known for sport fishing, birdwatching and exploring coral reefs.

Central Pacific

Hiking, cycling, horseback riding and sport fishing are just a few of the activities the Central Pacific region offers. Curious visitors can also explore rural tourism opportunities.

Costa Rica Regions

Central Valley

Home to our capital city, the Central Valley boasts fascinating museums, riveting theater and delicious food. Outside of the city you’ll find indigenous sites and natural wonders.

Costa Rica Regions

Guanacaste

Guanacaste is known as the cradle of our folklore and is home to beautiful landscapes ranging from tropical dry forests and pristine beaches to lowland mountain forests.

Northern Plains

Arenal Volcano towers over protected forests and heats natural hot springs. Rivers and waterfalls flow through landscapes that look like fairy-tale settings.

Puntarenas

Puntarenas is one of the most popular tourism regions, loved for its coastline dotted with inlets and islands. Explore the jungle and spot wildlife in the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Preserve.

South Pacific

The South Pacific area of Costa Rica is one of the most untouched regions and is covered in lush rainforests and fringed by stunning beaches.

Visiting from Europe? Explore the best version of Costa Rica based on your country of origin and immerse yourself in stories and travel ideas designed especially for you.

Biodiversity

Did you know? Costa Rica is home to 6% of the world’s biodiversity, and we’re dedicated to making this unique country a welcoming place for everyone.

Culture

The spirit of pura vida brings together a mix of global cultures and fuses them into a uniquely Central American experience. You won’t find anything else like it.

Sustainability

A global leader in sustainability, Costa Rica pioneers eco-friendly practices for travel and other industries – both within the region and around the world.

Experiences and activities

You can create the exact vacation you need. Let your interests lead you to try new things and enjoy what you love.

Costa Rica unveiled

There is so much to know about Costa Rica. Dive into our blogs to find out a little more about this dynamic country and the many different kinds of experiences you can have here.

Visit the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve

If you like cool climates, views filled with green and hikes, this could be the destination you’ve been looking for. The term “cloud forest” is no exaggeration, as you’ll be walking through trees in the midst of a dense fog, produced at 1,600 meters above sea level.
